articles.title: Census move signals Feb-March timeline for 2027 assembly polls in five states
articles.description: The Census exercise advancement in four states sets the election timeline for February-March. Manipur's assembly term ends first, followed by Goa, Punjab, and Uttarakhand. Uttar Pradesh's assembly term concludes later, allowing for early polls. The Election Commission will likely complete polls before Manipur's term expiry. The poll schedule for these five states may be announced in January 2027.

The first reportedly extended sick leave after being asked to work from home, while the second sought to use accumulated paid leave against his notice period. Users offered differing views on employee rights, professionalism and workplace expectations.

articles.title: “Someone else will clean it”: The mindset Bittu Tabahi challenged by cleaning a river alone and the psychology of doing what everyone else ignores
articles.description: Surendra Singh Choudhary, affectionately called Bittu Tabahi, took it upon himself to personally cleanse the Ajnar River in Madhya Pradesh. By investing his own resources and labor, he tackled the pressing issue of pollution. Bittu's commitment serves as a powerful reminder of how collective responsibility can sometimes lead to inaction, urging us to embrace personal accountability and inspire proactive efforts to restore our environment.

articles.title: Indian engineer detained in Moscow over 'drunkenness' charge; Wife appeals to PM Modi and UP CM Adityanath
articles.description: An Indian engineer working in Russia was detained by Moscow police on September 5. Chandan Gupta and a colleague were held at Red Square and are now at a police station. The Indian Embassy has requested consular access and is in contact with local authorities. Gupta's wife appealed for help, stating her husband did nothing wrong. She also expressed concerns about potential forced army conscription in Russia.

articles.title: India planning to modify Su-30 fighter jets
articles.description: The Defence Ministry is considering integrating Russian RVV BD missiles with Su-30 MKI aircraft. These advanced missiles can engage targets at long distances with high speed. This capability boost comes ahead of Russian President Vladimir Putin's visit to India. The Defence Acquisition Council will review this significant proposal today. India is also pursuing indigenous and foreign air-to-air missile upgrades.

articles.title: BRICS Summit 2026 dates: Check traffic advisories, venue, schedule and other details for this week
articles.description: The BRICS Summit 2026 will be held in New Delhi from September 11 to 13, with Bharat Mandapam at Pragati Maidan as the main venue. Delhi residents and visitors should expect traffic diversions and temporary restrictions on key roads as security arrangements and movement of foreign dignitaries intensify. Schools will remain closed on September 11, while commuters heading to the airport and railway stations are advised to leave early and use public transport where possible.

articles.title: What happened at IIT Mandi? Inquiry ordered after Bhagavad Gita-themed poster sparks caste discrimination row

Director Laxmidhar Behera distanced the institute from the student-led display, condemned caste discrimination and said the panel would examine how the poster was created and displayed.

articles.title: Trump’s envoys claim progress after Moscow, Kyiv talks: Can they bring Putin and Zelensky together?
articles.description: Donald Trump's envoys have revealed new details from their three-hour meeting with Vladimir Putin before rushing to Kyiv for talks with Volodymyr Zelensky. Steve Witkoff said the Moscow discussions were “good” and “concrete,” adding that the team was confident of a resolution, while Jared Kushner revealed plans to revive direct trilateral Russia-Ukraine-U.S. talks. But Zelensky called Donbas the central “issue of this war” and warned that fighting could continue through winter. With Trump's team now trying to turn Putin's demands and Kyiv's red lines into a “win-win” peace package, can the territorial deadlock finally be broken?

articles.title: Amit Shah speaks to Delhi CM, top officials after building collapse
articles.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah spoke with Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta and other senior officials after a five-storey building near Delhi University's south campus collapsed, leaving one dead and several trapped in the rubble. In a message posted on X, Shah said he was deeply distressed by the building collapse at Satya Niketan in Delhi. "Spoke with the chief minister, commissioner of police, Delhi, and the director general, NDRF, and assessed the situation on the ground," he said. Shah said the local administration and the NDRF are conducting intensive rescue operations in close coordination. "The injured are being provided with all necessary medical assistance. Praying for the speedy recovery of all those injured," he said. The 50-year-old building housing a boys' hostel collapsed in a congested bylane in Satya Niketan near DU's south campus on Sunday afternoon, officials said. Six people have been pulled out of the debris so far, of whom one was brought dead to the hospital

articles.description: The United Nations has endorsed the 'Equal Earth' map projection to replace the traditional Mercator map, which distorts the relative size of continents. Championed by Togo and the African Union, the 'Correct the Map' initiative aims to provide a more accurate representation of Africa's true size.

articles.title: ‘Can no longer be stopped’: AfD races towards historic win in Germany state vote
articles.description: Voting is currently taking place in Saxony-Anhalt's vital state election, representing an important benchmark for the far-right AfD party. The results will be crucial in assessing Chancellor Friedrich Merz's approach to migration and security, with weeks of coalition talks likely if no party secures a majority.
